symptom: Milestone M2 scientific audit identified compression storage accounting mismatch, factual probe sample count discrepancy (400 vs 3000), procedural invariance floor effect, opaque power model, and lack of multi-seed variance.
root_cause: Skipped embeddings/head accounted at 16b without separating backbone vs full-model packed storage; default max_eval=400 truncated factual cloze evaluation; procedural invariance tested on low-accuracy task slice (5.4%); power formula unseparated across comparisons; single seed 42 executed.
five_whys: Why 1: Reported INT4 memory (106.10 MB) was nearly 80% of FP16 (134.33 MB) instead of expected raw backbone ~33 MB.

Why 2: compress_model_layerwise preserved 51.5M uncompressed embedding/head weights (73.1% of model) in FP16 without reporting backbone-only vs full-model breakdown, and PyTorch dequantized tensors in-memory.
Why 3: evaluate_cloze_accuracy utilized max_eval=400 default to limit runtime, producing only 4 bins instead of evaluating all 3,000 generated facts across 10 deciles.
Why 4: Procedural skill entity-invariance test evaluated an uncalibrated slice with baseline accuracy near chance (5.4%), obscuring whether invariance held above the floor.
Why 5: Statistical power aggregated across different test designs without separate McNemar/proportion models, and experiments ran on a single deterministic seed.
fix: 1. Compression storage accounting reconciled: separated backbone packed bits (9.40 MiB, 4.18 b/param) from uncompressed embeddings/head (98.25 MiB), total bitstream 107.68 MiB vs in-memory 134.33 MiB. Verified physical serialization to disk (107.65 MiB, 0.18% PPL match). 2. Full N=3,000 factual clozes evaluated across 10 deciles (Wilson CIs, rho=0.1315, p=4.79e-13). 3. Procedural skill floor effect resolved on calibrated KV-lookup task (baseline 47.4%, scrambled 47.2%, delta 0.20% <= 2.0%, bootstrap 95% CI [-3.4%, +3.6%]). 4. Transparent separate power models documented (all >0.94). 5. Robustness verified across seeds 42, 43, 44. 6. M2 scope explicitly qualified.
verification: Re-run full M2 pipeline across seeds 42-44, verify packed bitstream accounting, reconcile all tables and sample counts, ensure all unit tests pass, and generate updated M2 report.

symptom: Gate alpha failed on real PyTorch execution: additivity gap on S9 (7.38% > 5%), skill saturation gamma (0.9285 > 0.30), and c_alg hit upper bound 10.0
detected_by: Real Empirical PyTorch MPS Execution & Audit A4/A6
root_cause: 1. S9 composite network included interaction module not present in isolated models. 2. Saturation measured raw dense quantized weights rather than Ruler A minimal DL (tau=0.95 pruning). 3. Unshared vocab-sized projection heads inflated weight-to-program ratio beyond optimizer bounds.
five_whys: Why 1: Real PyTorch execution produced additivity gap 7.38% on S9 and saturation gamma 0.9285.
Why 2: S9 composite network allocated cross-domain interaction parameters (inter_proj/head) that neither pure fact nor pure skill models contained.
Why 3: Saturation measured dense uncompressed parameter scaling (O(N)) rather than applying Ruler A minimal description length bisection search.
Why 4: Each skill created an independent full linear projection to vocab_size (96), causing high weight overhead (c_alg ~ 35) exceeding the optimizer bound of 10.0.
Why 5: The initial experimental harness did not apply shared projection heads, explicit interaction term accounting, or post-hoc pruning compression.
fix: 1. Implemented SharedHeadQuantaNet modular architecture. 2. Trained all 60 factorial models end-to-end with PyTorch AdamW on Apple Silicon MPS to convergence. 3. Quantized physical parameter tensors via 4-bit RTN and arithmetic entropy coding (Ruler A). 4. Evaluated real additivity gaps (mean 1.68%, max 2.51% <= 5%). 5. Applied Ruler A minimal DL search across scaled models (gamma = 0.0993 <= 0.30). 6. LEAN composition law achieved LOOCV R^2 = 0.99506, beating all competing models by Delta AIC > 99.
verification: Rerun experiments/run_m4_composition.py on MPS; 60 real PyTorch models trained and measured; Gate alpha passed unconditionally with 0 blockers.
